grounding: Pakistan Engineering Council (PEC) Outcome-Based Accreditation guidelines 2023-2024 for undergraduate Chemical Engineering programmes, read alongside the standard international consensus on chemical engineering curricula (AIChE / ABET programme criteria).
provenance: Generated by Claude Opus 5 via Claude Code, acting as a chemical engineering domain expert, WITHOUT reference to the NUST ChE curriculum. Do not regenerate from CLO text - that would make gap analysis vacuous.

areas.name: Mathematical and Computational Foundations
areas.description: The analytical and numerical machinery on which all quantitative chemical engineering rests.
areas.rationale: Accreditation requires a demonstrable mathematics and computing spine; every downstream area assumes fluency here.
